The '''Bakuran military police''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement organization]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Anya Foravis]] served with the police for a short time.
